body:
## What changed

Adds a certified upper bound for C_16 (Brezis–Gallouët–Wainger remainder constant on the 2D torus) in `constants/16a.md`, the README table row and "Recent progress":

2.1562247706 ≤ C_16 ≤ 2.1562256466

- **Upper bound (new).** Cauchy–Schwarz with weights |k|²(1+μ|k|²) gives F(δ) ≤ S1(μ)(1+μδ)/π − ln δ − ln(1+ln δ) for every μ > 0, where S1(μ) = Σ_{k≠0} 1/(|k|²(1+μ|k|²)). The right-hand side is convex in δ.
  - A branch-and-bound over δ ∈ [1, 4.9·10⁸] (84 boxes) uses a truncated S1 with a proven tail bound.
  - The choice μ = 1/(δ ln δ) bounds F by 2.0587 beyond 4.9·10⁸.
  - The page previously listed only the numerical ≈ 2.15627 [BDZ2013], which lies outside the enclosure.
- **Lower bound.** This builds on 2.156224 from #226. An explicit zero-mean trial function u = Σ_{0<|k|≤4000} e^{ik·x}/(|k|²(1+μ|k|²)), with μ = 0.1221 and lattice sums enclosed with outward rounding, gives 2.1562247706.

Certificates and checkers (Python 3 + numpy; each prints VERIFIED): https://github.com/maximusrufus/c16-bgw-certificates

Both rows carry an asterisk per CONTRIBUTING (self-archived computation). If #226 merges first, I'm happy to rebase onto it.
